name: Chicken Stir-Fry
steps: Heat the oven to 375°F. Pat the 2 pounds chicken thighs dry with paper towels.
Rub all over with 3 tablespoons olive oil and season generously with 2 teaspoons salt, 2 teaspoons black pepper, 1 teaspoon dried rosemary.
Roast 75 minutes, until cooked through and the juices run clear.
Rest 10 minutes before slicing so the juices settle. Serve warm.
